name: ImRabo Sub-Agent Registry
description: Curated declarative specialist agents for ImRabo. Manifests contain instructions and capability/dependency declarations only; executable code is not permitted.

agents.name: Research Agent
agents.description: Researches a topic, compares sources, and produces a structured evidence-based summary.

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews code changes for correctness, security, maintainability, and test gaps.

agents.name: Writing Editor
agents.description: Edits technical and business writing for clarity, consistency, and structure.
